observations: Photo shows a PlayStation console with a DualShock controller in front.
Console appears to be the older/“fat” PS4 style (large, boxy body).
There are visible scuffs/smudges on the console front panel and controller surfaces.
No clear view of model label/serial, no ports close-up, and no power-on screen shown.

claims.claim: PS4 Fat Double Pad Good Condition
claims.evidence: Only one controller is clearly visible in photo 0; console condition is not verifiable (no power-on test, no close-ups of ports/drive).
Photo 0 shows only one DualShock controller.

risks.risk: Whether it actually works (disc drive/HDMI/audio/controller ports) — photos can’t confirm functionality.
risks.proof: Seller video: power on + PS4 home screen, and a quick test of HDMI output and controller buttons.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/untested (worst case: may have faults).

risks.risk: Missing second controller (seller says double pad but only one is shown).
risks.proof: Photo showing both controllers side-by-side (front and back) and/or serial/model labels.

risks.risk: Storage/firmware/ban status (can affect value and usability).
risks.proof: Photo of Settings > System > System Information (storage size) and Settings > Account Management (no ban info shown, but can show account status).
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming good storage/clean status.

risks.risk: Physical damage/overheating risk (scuffs may hide deeper issues).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of vents, fan intake area, and any cracks; plus a short gameplay/benchmark video showing stable temperature (or at least continuous operation for 10–15 mins).
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically used and potentially needing cleaning/maintenance.

proof_requests: Video of the PS4 powering on to the home screen (HDMI working).
Photo/video showing both controllers (if truly double pad).
Photo of the console label/serial and Settings > System Information (storage).
Close-ups of ports (USB/HDMI/power) and vents; short run test video.
response.reason: The item type looks like a PS4 “fat” from photo 0, but the key value drivers (working status and whether there are two controllers) are not verifiable from the photos. Worst-case pricing depends on proof.
